How it works

Simple to work with, from first call to hands-off.

A clear path from "our reporting is a mess" to reports that deliver themselves.

Step 1

Audit

I map your data sources and the reports you rely on, and pinpoint where time and accuracy leak away.

Step 2

Build

I design clean reports and models around your real questions, checking the numbers as I go.

Step 3

Automate

I connect the sources and set everything to refresh and deliver on schedule — no manual steps.

Step 4

Support

I maintain and adapt your reporting as the business changes, so it keeps earning its keep.

Sound familiar?

If any of this rings true, there's time to win back.

  • The same report is rebuilt by hand every week or month.
  • Two systems say two different things and nobody's sure which is right.
  • The data lives in five spreadsheets and one person's head.
  • Decisions wait days because the numbers aren't ready.
